messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Symmetry-constrained ansatz parameterized by a few variables then globally optimized

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A 13-point configuration achieving a minimum triangle area of at least 0.0050 is obtained by placing the four corners of the unit square, four points at the midpoints of the four sides, four points at the centers of the four quadrants at coordinates (1/4,1/4), (3/4,1/4), (1/4,3/4), (3/4,3/4), and the center point at (1/2,1/2), yielding a D4-symmetric arrangement where the minimum area arises from nearly-collinear triples along the square's medians. Globally optimizing the four midpoints and four quadrant-centers as free parameters under D4 symmetry (with corners and center fixed) pushes the minimum area up to approximately 0.0065, with the binding constraint being triples of points clustered along the edges and diagonals."}
